title: Fix the Longest Streak
statement: The program below is meant to read an integer n, then a line with n integers, and print the length of the longest strictly increasing run of consecutive elements (a 'streak', where each element is strictly greater than the one before it). The code below has 3 subtle bugs. Fix them so it passes all test cases.
hints: The loop's range should let i reach the last valid index of nums - check the upper bound
'Strictly increasing' means each element must be greater than the previous one, not greater-or-equal
When the increasing run breaks, 'cur' is never reset back to 1 - trace through a list with a dip in it
